# NAT Documentation Requirements

Production NAT records should document:

- Rule name
- NAT type
- Source zone
- Destination zone
- Incoming interface if applicable
- Source address
- Destination address
- Protocol
- Port
- Translation pool
- Translated address
- Related security policy
- Business purpose
- Configuration state
- Verification date

Configuration state must be one of:

LEGACY_PRODUCTION

SRX320_TARGET

SRX320_VERIFIED_PRODUCTION

---
